court_name: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
petitioner: Giri Textiles, through Proprietor Chandrayya R. Pasnuri
respondent: Anthony Nadar And Jainam Silk Mills

directives.text: The order dated 22 December 2021 passed by the Labour Court, Thane in Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 and the order dated 17 October 2025 passed by the Industrial Court, Thane in Appeal (IC) No. 1 of 2022 are upheld.

Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 shall proceed before the Labour Court, Thane in accordance with law and be decided on its own merits, uninfluenced by any observations made in the impugned orders or in the present judgment, save and except on the issue concluded herein.
The Labour Court shall endeavour to dispose of the said application as expeditiously as possible and preferably within a period of six months from the date of receipt of this order.
directives.deadline_text: within a period of six months from the date of receipt of this order

directives.text: There shall be no order as to costs.

raw_summary: The High Court dismissed the writ petition filed by Giri Textiles, upholding the concurrent orders of the Labour Court and Industrial Court. The Court rejected the petitioner's objection that the application was non-maintainable due to alleged non-compliance with the approach notice requirement under Section 42(4) of the Maharashtra Industrial Relations Act, deeming it hypertechnical given the facts of the case. The Labour Court, Thane, was directed to expeditiously dispose of the original application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014, preferably within six months.
